_description: Shared log tracking which transcripts have been processed by each scheduled task. Each task adds its own key to the entry when it finishes processing a transcript. Tasks should check this log before processing and update it after completing their work.

_schema.folder: Which folder the transcript came from ('Transcripts' or 'Shorts Transcripts')
_schema.ff-article-pipeline: ISO timestamp when this task processed the transcript, or null if not yet processed
_schema.podcast-metadata-creator: ISO timestamp when this task processed the transcript, or null if not yet processed
_schema.weekly-ff-email: ISO timestamp when this task processed the transcript, or null if not yet processed
_schema.ff-social-posts: ISO timestamp when this task processed the transcript, or null if not yet processed
